---
title: "Data: games and sports"
---

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
source("data/catalogue/helpers.R")
downloads <- utils::read.csv("data/catalogue/downloads.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
ids <- c("lichess-2013-01", "konect-chess", "international-football-results", "retrosheet-gamelogs")
```

Contests between players or teams: online chess games, historical chess results, men's international football and Major League Baseball. Each game is a directed event (white to black, home to away, visitor to home); repeated pairings and seasonal schedules shape the rate.

The [data catalogue](data-catalogue.html) lists every dataset with its licence. Figures
and numbers on this page are aggregates computed from the files as published;
each section links the source and the code that reads it.

```{r summary-table}
summary_table(ids)
```

```{r sections, results = "asis"}
render_group(ids)
```
